_about: The cut list for the inbound beat: stretches of recordings/inbound.m4a (77s, Yoshua's real call to PacePay, call_ud2aboe) in order. { in, out } in seconds of the RAW recording; mute: true plays silence (the keypad PIN tones). Dropped: PacePay's 'Hmm'/'Okay' fillers, and the off-script tail ('Mm-hmm. Still checking. One sec. You chose card. Adds about $14 per month in interest.' — that is the $650 repair's interest, not the $900 — and Yoshua's 'All right, perfect. Thank you. Bye-bye.'), so 'Okay, card it is. Thank you.' goes straight to 'Okay, talk soon. Bye!'. Times from silencedetect (-50 dB) + per-slice whisper.

cuts.note: PacePay: Hi, this is PacePay, Yoshua's money assistant. For your security, please say or type your four-digit PIN.
Yoshua types the PIN on the keypad: MUTED (shown as ****)
PacePay: Thanks, you are verified. What would you like to know?
Yoshua: Can I afford a $900 laptop?
PacePay: If $900 comes out of checking today... (its 'Hmm' before it dropped)
Yoshua: What if I put the $900 on my credit card?
PacePay: Putting $900 on the card... (its 'Okay' before it dropped)
Yoshua: Okay, card it is. Thank you.
PacePay: Okay, talk soon. Bye! (the hang-up beep after it dropped)
